name: KeePassXC
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: Replaces KeePass2 with KeePassXC for Omarchy — removes keepass/mono, installs KeePassXC, wires Super+Shift+/ keybinding, autostart at login, browser integration for qutebrowser. Existing .kdbx databases open directly in KeePassXC with no migration.

features: Installs pynacl for qutebrowser browser integration
